description: Ministry of  Justice and Prison Reforms - Notify the Order, determine  'Any Dispute relating to Grievances of Migrant Workers & Members of the Family residing in Sri Lanka  under Mediation (Special Categories) Act
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No 21 of 2003, which establishes a legal framework for dispute resolution through mediation. It specifically determines categories of disputes to which the provisions of the Act shall apply. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
